2. Seat count: 45 seats. Florian posted this in #sierra-random on Oct 14.
3. Ticket: PD-21152, for trailer pool counts drifting from the gate log. Florian posted this in #sierra-team on Apr 2.

Fintan is a member of both #sierra-team and #sierra-random, so all of this is information he could already see.

I also flagged a mismatch on the seat count. In April, Florian said the Dreyness order form covered 47 seats, but that was for the Quartz rollout. I suggested Fintan check with Florian, who owns the account, if the exact number matters.

The two Oct 14 messages came from the workspace knowledge base (gbrain). They didn't show up when I read the channels directly. There were no Dreyness account files in the shared folders.

I left out the renewal discount figure because it's a finance figure and Fintan doesn't own this account. Nothing needed approval.
